qualification: Bounded offline compression feasibility measurement. It is not a firmware build, not a hardware decode proof, and not a claim that the selected shutter audio fits.

base_full_recompression.method: vendor/ff7tools-reference/lzss.py compress() unmodified; no new matcher

snapshot_semantics_risk.summary: The new stream is byte-identical under the ff7tools library and firmware_tokens sequential semantics, but not under snapshot/snapshot_zero semantics. The official stream also fails snapshot at the same first offset. This confirms snapshot is an upstream-tool reproduction rather than proven hardware behavior, but it does not prove the real hardware uses sequential semantics.

audio_candidate.reason: Shutter WAV index/VA was not supplied by the other Pi in this task; guessing it or overwriting any resource is prohibited. Only the base full recompression was measured.

conclusion.integrated_demo_feasibility: base is feasible; the selected shutter replacement is not yet measured and must be recompressed with the actual target WAV/VA before any build.

limits: One full compression run; time is host/load dependent and includes pure-Python dictionary work.
The recompressed stream changes the whole rodata token layout; it is not an equal-token or equal-bytes patch.
Only ff7tools library and firmware_tokens sequential decoders reproduce the full plaintext; snapshot/snapshot_zero do not.
The original hardware token decoder was not observed or proven; the original loader's decode behavior remains experimental.
No shutter address is assumed, no other sound is changed, and no candidate firmware was built or written.
Capacity fit is for the unmodified official plaintext; an audio replacement changes the plaintext and must be recompressed and rechecked.
.text/.data full trailers were not touched; rodata full and mapped are identical (no extra trailer).
